title: Proper base-change property
statement:
Let $f:X\to Y$ be a proper morphism of schemes [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Write $\mathrm{PBC}(f)$ if, for every morphism of schemes $g:Y'\to Y$, every cartesian square [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square]

$$
 \square:\quad
 \begin{array}{ccc}
 X'&\xrightarrow{g'}&X\\
 f'\downarrow&&\downarrow f\\
 Y'&\xrightarrow{g}&Y
 \end{array}
$$

completing $f$ and $g$ (with its chosen identification $X'\cong X\times_YY'$), and every torsion abelian sheaf [def-weil-pbc-torsion-etale-sheaf] $F\in\Ab(X_{\Et})$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], regarded as a complex concentrated in degree $0$, the derived exchange morphism [def-weil-pbc-derived-exchange]

$$
 \Ex_{\square,F}:g^{-1}Rf_*F\longrightarrow Rf'_*g'^{-1}F
$$

is an isomorphism in the bounded below derived category $\Dplus(Y'_{\Et})$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. The assertion concerns this specified map, not an unnamed isomorphism between its source and target.

blueprint_sketch.statement:
For a proper morphism $f:X\to Y$, define $\mathsf{PBC}(f)$ to mean that for
every morphism $g:Y'\to Y$, every associated Cartesian square $\square$, and
every torsion sheaf $F$ on $X_{\mathrm{et}}$, the map
$\operatorname{Ex}_{\square,F}$ is an isomorphism in the derived category.
The assertion includes the specified map of Definition
[def-weil-pbc-derived-exchange], not an unnamed isomorphism.

split_report.summary: Checked against the unit sk-def-pbc (statement only, no proof steps) and the blueprint node; the definition agrees with the Stacks Project's 'cohomology commutes with base change for f' (Etale Cohomology, Section 095S, paragraph before Lemma 0A4B), restricted to proper f. Split by one level: 'proper' repointed from the grab-bag def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions to def-weil-proper-morphism (Mathlib leaf IsProper); the grab-bag def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves replaced by two new nodes, def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves (Ab(X_et), Mathlib leaf Sheaf (smallEtaleTopology X) AddCommGrpCat) and def-weil-pbc-torsion-etale-sheaf (unsplit: Mathlib has IsAddTorsion for groups but no torsion sheaf), defined as in the unit by the canonical map colim_n F[n] -> F being an isomorphism, which uses def-pur-abelian-sheaf-kernel and a new Mathlib leaf def-weil-pbc-category-colimit. The claims the old statement carried (equivalence with torsion geometric stalks and with locally killed sections; not every F(U) torsion) moved to the new statement node lem-weil-pbc-torsion-sheaf-characterizations (unsplit, flagged unreachable, carried in the unit's realized.statement). Kept def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square and def-weil-pbc-derived-exchange (the specified map; being split by another worker) and added def-weil-pbc-derived-categories for 'isomorphism in D+(Y'_et)'. Lean: the attached AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.IsBaseChangeIso (no torsion hypothesis, all of D+) states something stronger than this node, false for proper f in general; the unit's AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.HasTorsionBaseChange (BaseChangeProperty.lean:116-139) quantifies over Lambda-module complexes in D+ with torsion cohomology, which for Lambda = Z implies this node's property (take K = F[0]) but is not literally the same.
